title: Lyn Buchanan met by three Nordic men at a diner
summary: Jason Jorjani tells of Lyn Buchanan met by three Nordic men at a diner, about unspecified at Diner in the US; Colorado Rockies, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Diner in the US; Colorado Rockies

tellings.quote: He said that he was confronted at a diner that he eats at regularly by three men.

plain: Jason Jorjani, a researcher, relays a story he credits to a man named Lyn Buchanan. According to Jorjani, Buchanan said he was confronted by three men at a diner where he regularly ate, men described as Nordic, meaning tall, fair and human-looking in the way some say certain visitors appear. The story also connects to the Colorado Rockies, and is told as a possible meeting with beings who only look human.
